interpolation: triangles SW-SE-NE / SW-NE-NW, same as build_campus height

elevation_metadata.dataset: Copernicus DEM GLO-30 Public, AWS 2021 release
elevation_metadata.attribution: produced using Copernicus WorldDEM-30 © DLR e.V. 2010-2014 and © Airbus Defence and Space GmbH 2014-2018 provided under COPERNICUS by the European Union and ESA; all rights reserved
elevation_metadata.limitations: DSM includes structures and canopy. OSM footprint + 18m masks are interpolated from 8 unaffected neighbors and smoothed sigma=1 source pixel. This is a relative approximate ground trend, not a surveyed DTM or step/retaining-wall measurement. Unmapped roofs and canopy may remain. 10m output grid does not improve source resolution.
elevation_metadata.model_zero_method: median of smoothed masked DSM at five main-building front-apron points; original detailed core geometry retained

transform.instructions: For lat/lon, compute east/north in meters, dot with each axis; add 8.5 to y. Geometry already converted. Keep existing main building and do not extrude OSM main building.

elevation_metadata.documentation: terrain_elevation.py and prepare_terrain_elevation.py; source evidence in terrain_source_samples.json
